description:
Hi,This is Raju. I am Recruiter at Randstad Technologies and I am reaching out in regards to your background. I have an exciting opportunity
  *Candidates MUST be able to work on W2 to qualify for this role.* 
 
 
 Job Title: SAP Business Objects Developer 
 Duration: 6 Months 
 Position Type: Contract to hire 
 Location:San Francisco, CA 
 Job description: Create WEBi reports and dashboards to support our distribution business analytic needs.

 Data will come from various sources like SAP BW; Oracle; SQL Server; Salesforce. com.

 Expert in various Business objects tools - Web Intelligence; IDT; UDT; Live Office; Data Federator; BI Launchpad; CMC; Scheduling.

 Ability to research data issues in SAP BW and SAP ECC

 Expertise with BW as a datasource and writing BW Queries using BEx Query Designer and creating complex workbooks in BEx Analyzer.

 Experience with Infoburst to e-mail reports and write files to ftp server.

 Expertise connecting to and building universes on SQL Server; Oracle; Salesforce; Google Analytics.

 10+ years functional experience SAP - BO/ BI/BW Modules.

 Must be familiar with Data Warehousing best practices.

 Please have a look at the below job requirement and reply back to me with your latest word format resume ASAP. Do let me know the best contact number to reach you. 

 Note : If you feel this job description does not suit your profile then kindly let me know your preferred job roles so that I can be in touch with you with similar jobs and you can refer me a suitable person 


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
